title: Solving the Yang-Baxter-Like Matrix Equation with an Anti-Diagonal Coefficient Matrix
content: When the coefficient matrix is an anti-diagonal non-singular matrix, we find solutions of the Yang-Baxter-like matrix equation by analyzing eigenvalues and eigenvectors of coefficient matrix. When the coefficient matrix is an anti-diagonal singular matrix, we find some properties of solutions of the Yang-Baxter-like matrix equation. Furthermore, we provide some examples to illustrate our findings.
